info.name: Studio API (all phases)
info.description:
Full HTTP test suite for the Studio FastAPI backend.

**Phase 1** — smoke (health, auth, workspaces, creative read, billing, admin reads)
**Phase 2** — CRUD (upgrades plan to studio, brand, research, agency, public API, monitoring, video draft)
**Phase 3** — heavy/opt-in (xAI, Stripe); skipped unless `runHeavy=true`

Run with Postman CLI:

```
postman collection run postman/studio-api.postman_collection.json -e postman/studio.local.postman_environment.json
```

Regenerate this file: `python postman/generate_collection.py`
